codeReview.summary: Most requested infrastructure and pilot migration changes were implemented, but a workflow gap remains: migrated modules now require compiled JS that is not guaranteed before several test workflows run.

issues.description: `test-node-run` and dependent scripts run without a compile prerequisite (e.g. package.json:71-84,85), while this commit removes tracked `lib/context.js`, `lib/hook.js`, and `lib/pending.js` (`git show --name-status` for commit 516ecee9). Runtime JS still requires those module paths (`lib/mocha.js:89,96`, `lib/runner.js:12`, `lib/runnable.js:4`, `lib/suite.js:12`). In a clean checkout (without ignored build artifacts), `test-node:*` workflows can fail unless compile runs first.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The infra-worker skill does not document the `allowJs` + emit conflict in mixed JS/TS in-place builds, which the worker had to discover during execution.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: handoff skillFeedback.suggestedChanges explicitly asks to clarify this incompatibility (handoff JSON lines 67-68); `.factory/skills/infra-worker/SKILL.md` has tsconfig guidance but no `allowJs` caveat (e.g. lines 21,31,38).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker used an initialization command that is not represented in shared services command metadata.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton includes `bash .factory/init.sh` as an execution step (worker-transcripts entry for session 210bcc92-77a4-4f32-a430-eb68e11f14f5), while `.factory/services.yaml` only defines install/compile/typecheck/build/lint/test commands (lines 1-7).

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission/state docs do not clearly define whether `.factory/**` operational artifacts should be committed as part of feature commits, and this feature commit included multiple such files.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: `git show --name-status 516ecee9` includes added `.factory/init.sh`, `.factory/library/*`, `.factory/services.yaml`, and `.factory/skills/*`; AGENTS scope text focuses migration scope but does not explicitly set commit rules for `.factory/**` artifacts.

summary: Review failed with one blocking issue: compile is not wired into key node test workflows that now depend on generated JS for migrated modules. Shared-state observations were also noted around skill guidance, services metadata completeness, and `.factory` artifact commit conventions.
